dataset: NASA LRO / LCROSS Lunar Polar Water-Ice Targets (Archived)
description: Permanently Shadowed Regions (PSRs) at the Lunar South and North Poles where cryogenic temperatures (< 110 K) trap water ice.
sourceLabel: NASA Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) & LCROSS Polar Volatiles Archive

targets.name: Shackleton Crater
targets.notes: Located directly at the Lunar South Pole; crater floor is permanently shadowed while rim peaks receive near-continuous sunlight (Artemis III candidate region).

targets.name: Cabeus Crater (LCROSS Impact Site)
targets.notes: Site where NASA's LCROSS impactor confirmed 5.6 ± 2.9% water ice by mass in the ejected plume in October 2009.

targets.name: Shoemaker Crater
targets.notes: Deep polar cold trap showing strong hydrogen suppression of epithermal neutrons in NASA LRO LEND measurements.

targets.name: Haworth Crater
targets.notes: Contains some of the coldest measured surface temperatures in the Solar System (~33 K via LRO Diviner).

targets.name: Faustini Crater
targets.notes: Permanently shadowed floor with high ultraviolet Lyman-alpha reflectance ratio detected by LRO LAMP.

targets.name: de Gerlache Crater
targets.notes: Adjacent to Shackleton; rim ridge is a primary Artemis exploration target overlooking a vast cold trap.

targets.name: Sverdrup Crater
targets.notes: South polar cold trap mapped by LRO LOLA laser altimetry and M3 infrared spectroscopy.

targets.name: Amundsen Crater PSR
targets.notes: Large South Pole floor with gentle slopes and extensive stable subsurface ice stability zones.

targets.name: Hermite Crater (North Pole Cold Trap)
targets.floorTempNote: Coldest spot recorded by LRO Diviner (26 K / -247 °C)
targets.notes: Southwestern floor of Hermite recorded 26 K in NASA LRO Diviner thermal maps, cold enough to freeze nitrogen and water.

targets.name: Peary Crater PSRs
targets.notes: Closest major crater basin to the Lunar North Pole with multiple permanently shadowed interior sub-craters.

targets.name: Whipple Crater
targets.notes: High circular polarization ratio (CPR) measured by NASA Mini-RF radar indicating coherent backscatter from thick water-ice deposits.

targets.name: Rozhdestvenskiy W PSR
targets.notes: Northern polar basin cold trap confirmed by LRO neutron and radar volatile surveys.
